hero.title_1: Analyze, process and visualize your data
hero.subtitle: DataSense Pro delivers the analytical power of professional software with the simplicity of a consumer app. No code, no specialized training.

features.title: The whole analysis cycle, in one place
features.subtitle: Six integrated modules cover 100% of survey and market data analysis needs.
features.m1_desc: CSV, Excel, SPSS, SQL databases, APIs… Full variable dictionary and automatic quality dashboard on import.
features.m2_desc: Cleaning, recoding, Top 2 Box, weighting and raking, sampling — all point-and-click.
features.m3_desc: Univariate, bivariate and multivariate analyses (PCA, clustering), Excel-grade pivot tables.
features.m4_desc: 20+ parametric and non-parametric tests with a guided selection assistant and automatic interpretation.
features.m5_desc: 3-step chart builder, 30+ chart types, significance testing, dynamic filters and real-time preview.
features.m6_desc: One-click branded automatic reports: PowerPoint, Word, PDF, Excel, shareable interactive dashboards.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From raw data to final report in three steps.
how.step1_desc: Drag and drop your file or connect your source. The platform detects everything automatically.
how.step2_desc: Statistics, tests and charts in a few clicks, with automatic recommendations.
how.step3_desc: Generate a professional branded report and share it with your team or clients.
